mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate signals a monetary policy response to labor market weakness, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an impending slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion when GDPC1 declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900,000 units, it signals a strong housing market that supports economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 900.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
